meta.title: Blip Toast — Modern Toast Notifications for React Native
meta.description: Blip Toast is a lightweight, beautiful toast notification library for React Native. Five variants, spring animations, promise support and a tiny TypeScript-first API.

hero.description: A lightweight, beautifully animated toast notification library for React Native. Five variants, promise support, six positions and a tiny TypeScript-first API.
hero.clickCard: Click a card to fire a real toast

features.title: Small API,
features.description: Everything you need for delightful notifications — and nothing you don't. Zero providers, zero config, just toasts.

variants.title: Five variants
variants.description: Default, success, error, warning and info — each with its own icon, tint and personality.

animations.title: Springy animations
animations.description: Smooth, physics-driven entrances and exits. Pick a preset — smooth, bouncy, subtle, snappy — or tune the spring yourself.

promise.title: Promise support
promise.description: toast.promise() morphs a loading toast into success or error the moment your async work settles.

positions.title: Six positions
positions.description: Anchored anywhere: top, bottom, or any of the four corners. Even per-toast with position overrides.

rich.title: Rich by default
rich.description: Timestamps and an optional animated progress bar keep toasts informative without stealing focus.

headless.title: Headless API
headless.description: Prefer your own UI? useToasts() exposes the live list so you can render everything yourself.

customizable.title: Fully customizable
customizable.description: Class names, custom fills, borders, icons, action buttons — every pixel is yours to style.

themeAware.title: Theme aware
themeAware.description: Light, dark and system themes, with per-toast overrides. Follows the device, follows you.

typescript.title: TypeScript first
typescript.description: Tiny, fully typed API with autocomplete for every option. No config, no providers, no ceremony.

playground.title: Drive it with
playground.description: Every button below fires a real blip-toast notification. Tune position, theme, duration and more — the container updates instantly.
playground.triggersHintEnd: — watch any corner of the screen.

installation.title: Up and running in
installation.description: One command, zero configuration, TypeScript included.

install.title: Install the package
install.body: Add <0>blip-toast</0> to your React Native project with your favourite package manager.

peers.title: Add peer dependencies
peers.body: The library ships with zero required peers — it only needs <0>react-native</0> and, if you use built-in icons, <1>react-native-svg</1>.

mount.title: Mount once, toast anywhere
mount.body: Render a single <0><ToastContainer /></0> at the root, then call <1>toast(...)</1> from anywhere. No provider, no context.

quickstart.title: Copy, paste,
quickstart.description: Every example below is live. Hit Run and watch the real toast appear on screen.

api.title: Everything,
api.description: A tiny, predictable surface. If you know sonner, you already know Blip Toast.

customization.title: Your brand,
customization.description: Style every part without fighting the library. Plain options, no abstractions.

richColors.title: Rich colors
richColors.description: Fill, border and accent — toasts that pop against any background.

presets.title: Animation presets
presets.description: Four entrance feels, or a hand-tuned spring when you need it.

styleHooks.title: Style hooks
styleHooks.description: Per-part classNames for wrapper, content, title, description and actions.

theming.title: Theming
theming.description: Light, dark or system — on the container or per toast.

container.position: Where toasts are anchored on the screen.
container.theme: Color scheme of the toast cards. Follows the device when "system".
container.offset: Distance from the screen edge (and status bar on iOS).
container.maxVisible: How many toasts are visible before older ones fade into the stack.

options.title: The toast message. Also passed as the first argument to toast().
options.description: Secondary line of text below the title.
options.variant: Visual style and icon. "loading" is set automatically by toast.promise().
options.duration: Time (ms) before the toast auto-dismisses. Use Infinity to pin it.
options.position: Per-toast anchor. Overrides the container position.
options.dismissible: Whether the toast can be dismissed by the user.
options.swipeToDismiss: Whether a swipe gesture dismisses the toast.
options.onDismiss: Called when the toast is dismissed (any reason).
options.onPress: Called when the toast card is pressed.
options.icon: Custom icon. Replaces the variant icon.
options.action: Action button inside the toast. successLabel swaps it after a tap.
options.border: Custom border to make toasts pop (rich colors).
options.spring: Manual spring control when you need fine tuning.
options.showTimestamp: Show the time the toast was created.
options.showProgress: Show an animated progress bar for the duration.
options.classNames: Style hooks for wrapper, content, title, description, action…

methods.toast: Show a default toast and return a handle with .dismiss() and .update().
methods.promise: Show loading → success/error automatically as the promise settles.
methods.dismiss: Dismiss a specific toast, or all toasts when called without an id.
